description: Source code for XNNPACK-based convolution operations in PyTorch, including functions for creating, running, and reordering convolution weights, as well as checking availability and usability of convolution configurations.

classes.name: ContextConv2D
classes.description: Structure holding convolution operator context, including operator handle, size, padding, stride, dilation, transposed flag, and groups.

methods.name: available
methods.description: Checks if convolution parameters are supported by XNNPACK.

methods.name: usable
methods.description: Checks if input tensor is suitable for convolution.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a convolution or deconvolution operator with specified parameters.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the convolution operator on input tensor.
